[

  "No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.",
  "Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.",

OWN INSPECTED REPAIR SPEC — modify the attached own initial native poster, maintaining a single flat opaque portrait 2:3 image.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

Observed defect: the very short shoot on the right currently has two spread, mature-looking leaves. Correct ONLY this developmental-state feature: replace the right shoot's leaf pair with tightly FOLDED, partially unopened young leaves of the same pointed-oval broadleaf anatomy as the tall plant. Each folded leaf should be narrow, cupped along its central vein, with the two lamina halves touching or overlapping, no fully spread side-vein fan. Show one central pale slit and a clear rolled/folded edge to communicate an emerging bud that has not yet unfurled. Keep the two young folded tips at approximately the same upper extent as the existing short shoot, and keep its stem still much shorter than the tall left shoot. Do not make it into a flower, seed capsule, tiny icon or another species.

Maintain the substantive exposed root network continuously connecting both shoots through the same thick horizontal rootstock. Preserve the tall left shoot's four opened leaves, stem curvature, carved vein logic, and uneven organic ascent; preserve the connected root junctions, substantial branching primary/secondary roots, crop and margins. Keep the palette of forest-green botanical ink, burnt-orange title and pale warm-yellow opaque background, the relief-cut hand-drawn genre and the title-to-rootstock boundary composition.

Preserve the literal title exactly once with original word spaces, one horizontal line, intact readable Hangul, thick robust hand-drawn strokes, broad syllable proportions, clear counters, and the current grounded position flanked by both stems just above the common rootstock. Keep every leaf, stem and root separate from glyph strokes; do not overlap text. Keep copy size, stroke logic and clear spaces equivalent to the attached image. No other copy, lettering, numbers, logos, labels, watermarks, panels, contact sheet or mockup. This repair is one single independent flat opaque poster, not an extra variant or experiment. Root connections and the unequal growth must remain recognizable with the title hidden and in a reduced view.

planned_argument_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace
reference_role: exact own initial returned edit target; no user assets supplied

own_observed_repair_cause.impact: Unequal developmental state is less specific than assigned.
own_observed_repair_cause.planned_correction: Replace only this pair with closed/folded developing leaves of the same anatomy while maintaining height, root connection and title.

Tall open-leaved shoot and much shorter emerging shoot of consistent species anatomy
Clearly continuous shared rootstock and substantial branching root network
Forest-green and burnt-orange relief-cut drawing on pale warm-yellow opaque 2:3 field
Grounded word group between unequal growth and roots
